rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: On 3 June 1991 the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha rose to propose a resolution on the demise of Shri Rajiv Gandhi on 21 May 1991; the resolution mourns his passing and records that he was assassinated.

locator.item: Resolution on the demise of Shri Rajiv Gandhi, former Prime Minister; MR. CHAIRMAN

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Speaking on the resolution on 3 June 1991, the Minister of Finance and Leader of the House, Shri Yashwant Sinha, says that Shri Rajiv Gandhi was not only the President of the Congress Party but also a statesman and national leader.
